The config file is not missing—it is malformed.

Commit `996a57e…` changed [SystemConfig.class.php](/home/oem/IdeaProjects/testcenter2/backend/src/helper/SystemConfig.class.php:88) from wrapping `PASSWORD_PATTERN` in quotes to storing it raw.

That causes this startup chain:

1. `PASSWORD_PATTERN=^.*$`
2. `writeConfigIni()` writes `pattern=^.*$`
3. PHP’s INI parser rejects the unquoted `^`
4. `parse_ini_file()` returns `false`
5. Line 40 incorrectly reports every parse failure as `Application config file is missing!`

I confirmed inside the running container:

```text
exists=yes
parses=no
syntax error, unexpected '^' ... config.ini on line 21
```

The commit fixed the in-memory value but broke INI serialization. The proper fix is to quote/escape string values when writing `config.ini`, while keeping `SystemConfig::$password_pattern` itself unquoted. No files were changed during this diagnosis.

I’ll implement the narrow serialization fix and add a regression test at the configuration-writing seam. The diagnosis points to quoting only the password regex when producing `config.ini`, keeping the runtime pattern unchanged. I’ll preserve the unrelated working-tree changes.

+      foreach ($section as $key => $value) {

+        if (property_exists(self::class, $propertyKey)) {
+          if ($propertyKey == 'bruteForceProtection_sessions' && is_string($value)) {
+            $value = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', trim($value))));
+          }
+          self::$$propertyKey = $value;

+
+    if (

+      (!isset(self::$system_veronaMax) or !self::$system_veronaMax) or
+      (!isset(self::$system_veronaMin) or !self::$system_veronaMin)
